T1_KIR_holonomy_visible_vs_recognition.statement: The I, R, K operator system is exactly closed and finite (8 elements, {+-1} x {I,R,K,RK}, in the 2x2 representation — the scalars are real, so no factor of i occurs) with R^2 = -I, K^2 = I, RK = -KR. Explicit KIR words are certified that are the IDENTITY under the declared shadow projection while their holonomy is -I: visibly closed loops whose recognition holonomy does not return. Others close in both sectors. The lawful holonomy ledger closes the residue exactly. Visible endpoint return does not imply EMK topological return — the appendix's KIR obstruction theorem, as an exact witness

T2_cochains_and_seam_charge_conservation.statement: On an explicit finite complex (square with diagonal, one face filled) d1 d0 = 0 exactly and H^1 has rank EXACTLY 1. For a CLOSED cochain the seam charge is EQUAL on homologous cycles — certified with two cycles differing by the boundary of the filled face — and zero on boundaries; a coboundary has charge zero on every cycle; and a non-closed cochain is provably not a class function. Seam charge is conserved on recognition homology classes, and a nonzero class is closed but not locally removable

T3_determinant_charge_without_logarithms.statement: The appendix's additive log-determinant cochain is certified in its equivalent MULTIPLICATIVE form, so no logarithm is evaluated: edge charges are determinant ratios and the loop charge is their product, invariant under edge refinement and realized by explicit matrices. THE COROLLARY, as an exact witness: a loop whose GLOBAL determinant returns exactly to its initial value while its subcycle charges are 6 and 1/6 — determinant return does NOT imply topological closure unless every active additive charge vanishes or is lawfully ledgered, and the ledger neutralizes it exactly

T4_residue_trichotomy_and_empty_middle.statement: Every residue is exact, closed-but-not-exact, or open — decided here by exact rank computation with a witness of each and an EXPLICIT beta for the exact one. Only the exact class is locally removable: the closed non-exact class survives every coboundary correction with its charge unchanged. BRIDGE: CFE-U certified H^1 = 0 on the response complex, so THE MIDDLE CLASS IS EMPTY THERE — every closed response is exact and no stable seam charge can exist in that algebra. The middle class is nonempty exactly when H^1 is nontrivial, as the unfilled cycle here exhibits. The trichotomy is a statement about the complex, not a universal law

T5_sheet_rotation_class.statement: The sheet rotation S_(alpha,n) acts with an exact cocycle: phase and sheet index add, and the winding terms differ from the naive sum by an exactly computed cocycle correction. Phase is carried as an EXPONENT in Z/K and never evaluated as a root of unity. Certified witness: a loop with total turn exactly 0 mod K — visible phase return on the circle — whose sheet index is 2 and winding 6, i.e. a nonzero sheet-rotation class; and controls where the class vanishes entirely. The visible phase circle forgets sheet index and winding; the recognition topology retains them

T6_seam_survival_across_a_cut.statement: An object survives an EMK cut exactly when EVERY ACTIVE sector closes. Certified: a witness closing in the visible sector while KIR and memory stay open — survival in the shadow topology only, not in the EMK topology; the full-closure case; exact ledgered closure and its failure under a wrong ledger; and monotonicity — deactivating a sector can only turn an open verdict into a closed one, so the ACTIVE SET is load-bearing and must be declared before the verdict, never after seeing it
